Name: IdaIda's Craftables (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff][/color][/url][color=#9900ff][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url][/color]
This mod replaces all the vanilla craftables. The machines look similar to the vanilla sprites, so they're easy to recognize. A lot of decorative items have a new look. To keep with the look with my other mods, the aesthetic is somewhat witchy and magical and slightly less saturated. The colors also fit with my other mods.
There are more options for natural decorations, like seasonal flowers, edited statues and crystals.

This mod also already includes all my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13971][color=#8e7cc3]scarecrows[/color][/url]. 

[b]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83170493][color=#8e7cc3]itzyitzme[/color][/url] for making the AT conversion.[/b]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url] 
All the sprites in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.
